name: release-please
description: Use when the user wants to automate releases, versioning or changelogs with GitHub Actions; set up or configure release-please (pipelines, pre-releases, monorepos); write release-please-compatible Conventional Commits; tag versions or publish to npm, PyPI, crates.io, Maven or Docker automatically; or troubleshoot why a release PR wasn't created — even without naming release-please ("automate my npm releases", "semver automation", "pre-release workflow"). For multi-repo git operations with submodules, use multi-repo-git-ops instead.
